inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 164.8M shares outstanding at 2026-10-20 (Q3-2026 10-Q cover) + 2.3M dilutive options/awards (Q3-2026 EPS note). Held FLAT because SBC (incl. equity-award tax payments) is fully expensed in the flows; charging dilution as well would double-count. IQV is an active repurchaser (FY2025 $1,244M, 9M-2026 $950M), so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K FY2025 / 10-Q Q3-2026 cash flow statements, TTM to 2026-09-30: SBC add-back 303 (247 - 187 + 243) + 'Payments related to employee stock incentive plans, net' 44 (67 - 66 + 43). No combined adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation figure in the filings, so the two lines are summed (the payments line is net of option proceeds, so it is not an overstatement).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T21:00:30Z regular close (Friday; last close before the 2026-11-08 valuation date)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD WACC. Cost of equity 10.3% = US 10y ~4.3% + beta ~1.2 x 5.0% ERP. After-tax cost of debt ~4.6% (marginal coupons 4.6-6.4% on the 2026 EUR/USD issues, ~21% tax). Market weights: equity ~$45.4B (167.1M x price), net debt $13.8B -> D/V ~23%. WACC ~8.9%, rounded to 9.0% and held identical across scenarios (risk is charged in the scenario paths and weights, not the rate).
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: lease cost (~$160-178M/yr, FY2025 10-K lease note) sits in SG&A and therefore inside EBITDA; operating lease liabilities are NOT in total_debt. One treatment, in the flows. lease_cost_pct_path left at 0 because the charge is already inside the EBITDA margin.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI of $131M (Q3-2026 balance sheet, book) deducted in the equity bridge; NCI share of income is ~$5M/9M, immaterial to the flows, so flows are left consolidated.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (SKILL.md routing: operating company - CRO + healthcare data/analytics services, not a bank/REIT/holdco). No memory entry existed; this is a fresh build. FY0 = FY2026E at the guidance midpoint ($17,350-17,500M, raised at Q3-2026) because the balance sheet is dated 2026-09-30: projecting FY2026 as year 1 from FY2025 would credit ~9 months of FY2026 cash already reflected in the Q3 net debt. The cost is that Q4-2026 cash flow (~$0.5-0.6B, ~$3/share) is omitted - a small conservative bias. EBITDA BASIS: margin paths are GAAP EBITDA (income from operations + D&A) with SBC added back, i.e. pre-SBC but AFTER restructuring and acquisition/integration costs. IQV books restructuring every year (FY2023-25: $84M/$67M/$105M; 9M-2026 $150M) so it is treated as recurring, not adjusted away; this basis runs ~1.2pp below company 'Adjusted EBITDA' (FY2026 guide $4,025-4,055M = ~23.2%). History on this basis: FY2022 21.7%, FY2023 22.2%, FY2024 22.9%, FY2025 21.9%, 9M-2026 21.1%. REPORTED FCF IS POST-INTEREST: last_fcf/reported_fcf are levered (after ~$650M cash interest); the component engine builds UNLEVERED flows and subtracts net debt once. Unlevered owner FCF TTM ~ 2,079 + 647 x (1-0.21) - 347 = ~$2.24B (~13% of revenue), which is the cross-check for year 1 of the base path (~13.8%). interest_income set to 0: net DEBT of $13.8B, so there is no cash pile to double-count. ACQUISITIONS: IQV spends $0.6-1.7B/yr on bolt-ons (FY2025 $1,714M; 9M-2026 $589M) that the engine does not charge; to stay consistent, the growth paths from FY2027 are ORGANIC-style rates (~5-6% base), not reported growth that includes ~2-3pp of bought revenue, and the D&A % glides down from 6.9% to 5.0% so the acquired-intangible tax shield is not perpetuated. SEGMENTS: the Jan-2026 reorganisation (TAS + CSMS + R&DS -> Commercial Solutions + R&DS, with Real-World Late Phase moved into R&DS) makes segment series pre/post 2026 non-comparable; only consolidated revenue/EBITDA history is used for the paths. Equity bridge adds investments in unconsolidated affiliates ($438M book) because their earnings (equity-method, below operating income) are excluded from the flows.

equity_bridge.item: Investments in unconsolidated affiliates at book
equity_bridge.note: Q3-2026 10-Q balance sheet line 1470; equity-method earnings sit below income from operations so are excluded from the flows (matching-asset rule)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: organic revenue growth (FY2022-25 revenue CAGR 4.2% through a weak biopharma funding cycle; FY2026 guide ~7-8% incl ~2.5pp acquisitions; NTM R&DS backlog conversion +16% YoY to $9.4B)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (1.1% 5y / 4.8% 3y) is not a usable growth anchor: book equity is depressed by ~$1.0-1.4B/yr of buybacks funded partly with debt. EPS 5y CAGR (40%) is distorted by the depressed FY2020 base (COVID + Q4-2016 merger accounting legacy). Revenue and owner-FCF CAGRs are used instead.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - equity-award tax payments (interest income not stripped: net debt). FY2022 and FY2020 equity-award payments are estimates (~$60M/~$55M) because the FY2023+ 10-Ks only disclose 2023-2025 ($61M/$64M/$67M). Owner-FCF CAGR (9.3% 3y) runs slightly ABOVE reported (8.9%) because SBC grew slower than FCF over FY2022-25; that reversed in 2026 (SBC 9M-2026 $243M vs $187M), which is why the SBC path starts at 2.1% of revenue rather than FY2025's 1.5%. FCF here is levered (post-interest) and interest paid rose $343M -> $647M FY2021-25, so unlevered cash generation grew faster than these CAGRs show.

base.growth_rates_rationale: FY2027 6.0%: NTM backlog conversion +16% YoY and Q3-2026 bookings $3.2B (+15%) support R&DS ~6-7%; Commercial Solutions ~5%; little acquired revenue assumed. Decays to 3% by year 9 - close to biopharma R&D spend growth plus modest outsourcing penetration.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Pre-SBC, post-restructuring EBITDA. FY2025 21.9%, 9M-2026 21.1% (restructuring elevated at $150M). Recovers to the FY2024 level (22.9%) by year 4 as restructuring normalises and AI-driven delivery productivity offsets wage inflation; no expansion beyond 23%.
base.da_pct_rationale: 9M-2026 D&A 7.0% of revenue, heavily acquired-intangible amortization. Glides to 5.0% (capex 3.7% + ~1.3pp ongoing bolt-on amortization) so the amortization tax shield is not capitalized in perpetuity.
base.capex_pct_rationale: Property, equipment and capitalized software: FY2025 $603M (3.7%), 9M-2026 $483M (3.7%); FY2021-24 3.9-4.6%.
base.cash_tax_rationale: Unlevered rate on EBIT. GAAP ETR 15.8% FY2025, 18.0% FY2024, 19.7% Q3-2026; cash taxes $295-340M FY2023-24. Ramps to 21% as Pillar Two / geographic-mix benefits are assumed not to persist.
base.wc_rationale: CRO working capital (unbilled receivables vs advance billings/deferred revenue $2.3B) has been roughly neutral: OCF less (EBITDA - cash interest - cash tax + SBC) was +$30M FY2025, +$78M FY2024, -$274M FY2023.
base.narrative: Biopharma funding recovery holds at a normal pace; bookings strength converts to mid-single-digit organic growth; margins return to ~23% pre-SBC after the 2026 restructuring wave; bolt-on M&A continues but is not credited.

scenario_narratives.base: Biopharma R&D budgets recover at a normal pace after the cautious 2025: Q3-2026's $3.2B of net new R&DS bookings and the +16% YoY next-twelve-months backlog conversion carry FY2027 organic growth to ~6%, fading to ~3% as the cycle matures. The Jan-2026 two-segment structure and restructuring programme bring pre-SBC EBITDA margin back to ~23% (FY2024 level) by year 4. IQVIA.ai is a delivery-cost tool, neither a large new revenue line nor a disintermediator. Bolt-on M&A continues but is excluded from both growth and cash flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: A sustained biotech funding upcycle plus share gains from the largest CRO/data platform: bookings stay at 2026 levels, backlog burn accelerates, and organic growth runs 7-8% for three years. IQVIA.ai becomes a genuine differentiator with top-20 pharma (19 of 20 integrating at launch), lifting data/analytics pricing and clinical delivery productivity, so margins expand to 25% pre-SBC. Terminal growth 3% and an 18x cap reflect a durable data moat (1.2B+ patient records).
scenario_narratives.bear: Biotech funding relapses (as in 2023-25) and cancellations rise - the $2.1B Q3-2026 inactive-trial backlog write-down is a preview - holding growth to 2-3%. Generative/agentic AI lets large pharma internalize analytics and parts of trial operations (a risk IQV's own 10-K flags), compressing Commercial Solutions pricing; drug-pricing policy (MFN, IRA) trims client R&D budgets. Pre-SBC EBITDA margin falls to 20%, working capital absorbs cash, and a 13x cap reflects a slow-growth, AI-exposed services business carrying $16B of debt.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% default): leverage of ~3.4x net debt/adjusted EBITDA magnifies any downturn into equity value, biopharma funding is demonstrably cyclical, and AI disintermediation of the data business is a live, company-acknowledged risk. Base 50%: guidance has been raised twice in 2026 and backlog supports the near term. Bull 30% (below the 35% default): it needs both a sustained funding upcycle and AI to turn into pricing power, two independent things.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Strict owner-FCF basis: SBC and equity-award tax payments are expensed, the share count is held flat (funded by an active buyback), flows are unlevered and net debt is deducted once, recurring restructuring is treated as an operating cost, and acquisitions are neither paid for nor credited (organic growth paths). On that basis the value hinges on whether a ~23% pre-SBC EBITDA margin and mid-single-digit organic growth are sustainable for a CRO/data platform carrying $13.8B of net debt.
key_risks_to_valuation: Leverage: $16.1B gross debt; a 1-turn change in the EV multiple moves equity per share by ~$22 (EBITDA ~$3.8B / 167M shares)
Biopharma/biotech funding cycle drives R&DS bookings and cancellations
AI disintermediation of Commercial Solutions data/analytics pricing
Acquisition spend ($0.6-1.7B/yr) is excluded from both flows and growth; if bought growth earns below the WACC the model is generous, if above it is conservative
FX: ~30% of revenue non-USD; EUR debt partially hedges
